Market today:
Mixed signals. Strong AI demand continues to boost chip names, but rising Treasury yields and geopolitical tensions are creating headwinds. This push-pull dynamic means volatility is likely.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-53.92%) and SPAL (-33.48%) are your primary concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns are amplified, and they decay over time. SMH is also down (-10.9%). Remember, margin amplifies drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any escalation in geopolitical tensions, as these can quickly impact your growth-heavy portfolio. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for further decay.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions while staying alert to opportunities in core AI/chip names.
plays: SOXL: Your -53.92% loss on this leveraged ETF is significant. Consider trimming or setting a tighter, active stop to manage further downside risk.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is already down -33.48%. Review your stop loss to protect capital, as these instruments move fast and decay.
ASML: With strong AI demand and a direct positive headline, consider a new buy at the scanner's entry 1708.26-1706.55, stop 1700.54.
